name: ETH Zurich
description: ETH Zurich is Switzerland's federal institute of technology in Zurich, founded in 1855. It focuses on science, engineering, mathematics and architecture.
whyIncluded: ETH runs the Singapore-ETH Centre, its only research centre outside Switzerland, set up in 2010 with Singapore's National Research Foundation at the CREATE (the Campus for Research Excellence and Technological Enterprise); it offers English-taught master's programmes, and Switzerland is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 280 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate of rent, meals, local transport, study materials and personal costs for 12 months a year. Excludes health insurance and tuition.
livingCosts.notes: ETH Financial Aid Office 'Study and Living Costs, international students (approximate)' PDF, annual figures / 12: rent (room incl. heating, canton of Zurich average 2024) CHF 11,300; meals incl. refectory CHF 7,200; public transport (Zurich city, age 25 or under) CHF 586; personal = individual expenses CHF 1,680 + study material CHF 1,000. Excludes health insurance (CHF 1,320), excursions (CHF 500), tuition and semester fees. ETH's own total incl. insurance is CHF 22,100 a year.

programmes.name: BSc Mechanical Engineering
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students who move to Switzerland to study, plus compulsory semester fees for sport and student services. A one-off CHF 150 application fee is extra. Tuition is inflation-adjusted every four years from 2029.
programmes.notes: Fee group 2 (students who move to Switzerland to study): threefold tuition CHF 2,190 per semester x 2, in force since autumn 2025 and indexed to the CPI every four years (first in 2029). Compulsory semester fees ASVZ sports 35 + scholarship fund 7 + VSETH 32 = CHF 74 x 2. One-off application fee CHF 150 for a non-Swiss matriculation certificate. Exam fees included. 3-year (180 ECTS) bachelor's taught in German. 2024 compulsory fees from the Wayback Machine (via translate relay): ETH 'Tuition fees' page capture 2024-09-17 ('Tuition fee: CHF 730/Semester'; tripling 'from autumn semester 2025') and its compulsory-fees table JSON (/en/studies/financial/tuition-fees/_jcr_content/par/table.tableComp.json, capture 2024-09-29): 'Total compulsory semester fee CHF 74.00' = ASVZ 35 + Scholarship fund 7 + VSETH 32, so 74 x 2 = CHF 148. oneOffFees deliberately left out of the 2024 row (calculator falls back to current CHF 150): the 2024 bachelor 'How to apply (non-Swiss matriculation certificate)' captures (2023-11-29, 2024-02-22, 2024-03-06) say only that 'an application fee is charged' without the amount, and the tuition-fees PDF captures (2024-03-12, 2024-05-07, 2024-11-23) could not be fetched (the relay cannot pass PDFs; r.jina.ai and WebFetch are blocked from web.archive.org; the PDF is not in Common Crawl). 2024 application fee from the ETH fee ordinance (Verordnung des ETH-Rates über die Gebühren im Bereich der ETH, Gebührenverordnung ETH-Bereich, SR 414.131.7), consolidated version 'Stand am 1. Januar 2023' on fedlex (https://www.fedlex.admin.ch/eli/cc/1995/3853_3853_3853/20230101/de; filestore HTML fedlex-data-admin-ch-eli-cc-1995-3853_3853_3853-20230101-de-html-4.html). Fedlex SPARQL lists the consolidated versions as 2018-09-01, 2023-01-01 and 2025-05-01, so the 2023-01-01 text was in force from 1 Jan 2023 to 30 Apr 2025 and covers the whole 2024 application round (bachelor's applications for autumn 2024 ran Nov 2023 to Apr 2024). Anhang Ziff. 2.2.1 'Anmeldegebühr für die Bearbeitung von Bewerbungen ... Studierende mit ausländischem Ausweis': ETHZ CHF 150 (CHF 50 with a Swiss certificate). The same version's Anhang 1.1.1 gives the bachelor's tuition as CHF 730 per semester and Ziff. 2.1 the scholarship fund contribution as CHF 7, matching the row's tuition and fees. 2024 row now oneOffFees 150; tuition and compulsory fees unchanged.

programmes.name: BSc Human Medicine
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students plus compulsory semester fees. The university states this programme is open only to Swiss passport or settlement permit holders, so it is normally not open to Singaporeans.
programmes.notes: Fee group 2 (students who move to Switzerland to study): threefold tuition CHF 2,190 per semester x 2, in force since autumn 2025 and indexed to the CPI every four years (first in 2029). Compulsory semester fees ASVZ sports 35 + scholarship fund 7 + VSETH 32 = CHF 74 x 2. One-off application fee CHF 150 for a non-Swiss matriculation certificate. 3-year (180 ECTS) bachelor's taught in German (C1 required); graduates continue to a 3-year Master of Medicine at a partner university (Zurich, Basel or USI Lugano), where the registrable federal diploma is taken. Only 100 places a year, awarded through the aptitude test (EMS); ETH states the programme is open only to holders of a Swiss passport or Swiss settlement permit, so Singaporeans without one cannot normally enrol.
